Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores.

Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics.
r: You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.

This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure.

We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects.

Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision.
Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces.
Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers.
Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards.
Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases.
Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency.
Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers.
Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization.

Location Al Mamsha Street, PO Box 24970, Dubai, United Arab EmiratesVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about mixing drinks. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our bartenders have the basics down, but are constantly on the look-out for new trends, micro-local offerings, and guests’ evolving needs. They are not just a beverage enthusiast, but also the host of the space. Their role goes beyond the bar itself to take ownership of guest service more broadly and do what needs to be done. Bartenders will use their knowledge and expertise to make the bar look and function flawlessly. They will build relationships with others across the hotel and in the community, to anticipate and deliver on our guests’ needs. They should be passionate about the guest service experience, but also have an eye for detail – from the money that moves through their hands, to the information they provide to guests, to the quality of their drinks.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, protecting company assets, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring your uniform and personal appearance are professional. Bartenders will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time) and taking a hands-on approach to their work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Bartenders – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: The Sales Officer provides Ahli Bank customers with a broad range of financial services that exceed expectations by ensuring each interaction is handled with competence, efficiency, and professionalism. Services are delivered promptly and accurately, and any issues are resolved seamlessly to create a hassle-free experience. This approach enhances customer satisfaction, fosters long-term relationships, and reinforces Ahli Bank's commitment to exceptional service and care.
r: Achieve Individual Sales and Branch Targets: Consistently meet or exceed individual monthly sales targets and contribute to the branch's overall sales performance by supporting the team in achieving collective goals.

Team Collaboration and Staff Support: Actively contribute as a team player to achieve branch goals based on key performance indicators. Provide guidance and coaching to new staff, helping them integrate quickly into the bank.

Customer Acquisition and Business Development: Contact potential customers daily, through both in-branch and outside sales calls, to identify new business opportunities. Maintain detailed reports on closed deals and customer interactions.

Market Awareness and Competitive Analysis: Continuously observe the competition and maintain up-to-date knowledge of the local market position to inform strategic decisions and adjust sales approaches accordingly.

Process Adherence and Audit Compliance: Strictly adhere to branch processes and promptly report any deviations to the Senior Personal Banker, ensuring compliance with policies and contributing to a favorable branch audit rating.
Service Improvement and Feedback: Provide constructive feedback on products, services, and processes to help reduce cycle times, lower costs, and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

Customer Retention and Complaint Resolution: Work to minimize customer attrition and grow the bank's customer base by improving service levels and resolving complex customer complaints in coordination with other team members.
Diverse Customer Handling: Provide high-quality service to customers from diverse demographics, handling inquiries and issues without bias regarding nationality, income, or race.

Sales Reporting and Goal Tracking: Attend weekly sales meetings with the Branch Manager to discuss progress and strategies, report on target achievements, and participate in follow-up meetings to ensure consistent performance improvement.
Process Innovation, Automation and Digitalization: Drive continuous process improvement through innovative, automated, and digital solutions where required.
Business Control and Governance: Ensure adherence to the bank's policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards in all operational activities.
Self and People Development: Continually update your knowledge through learning, on-the-job training, or project involvement, and encourage and support others to do the same.
Minimum Higher Diploma; Bachelor's Degree preferred.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the banking industry.
